Permits & License Committee  March 28, 2024
Minutes  Page 1 of 4

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  March 28, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on March 28, 2024 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera , Planning Department
  Cpt.Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services & Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on March 14, 2024.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Christopher Jennings DBA Hoonigan to host a 4 3 Donuts event at 805 W. Manchester
  Blvd., Randys donuts, PrivateProperty, on Wednesday, April 3, 2024 2024, from 2:00 p.m
  – 6:30p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Applicant to adhere to all recommendations outlined by the IPD /
  Planninng Department/ Public Works Department ; Approval for 1 day event at Randy’s
  Donuts; Applicant to hire two (2) police officers for public safety; two (2) TCO and four (4)
  additional license security guards; applicant must submit final map; No obstruction on
  Manchester / La Cienega sidewalk; must submit Agreement document from Three
  Weavers to Inglewood Finance Department.Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00384113)
 Permits & License Committee  March 28, 2024
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

Item #2:  Gregory Johnson DBA Hannibal Media Group to host a Buss for America 2024 Event on
  Pincay Drive and Kareem Court; Public Property, on Thursday, April 4, 2024 from 11:00
  a.m. -1:00 p.m. Applicant to hire one (1) Sergeant; two Inglewood Police Officers; four (4)
  TCO’s; six (6) additional Licensed Professional Security Guards to assist IPD with Public
  Safety; must provide Public Works Department with a Traffic Control Plan; Stage point of
  contact / installer structure; Motion carried unanimously with a decision to have the
  item held over for further review (Activity No. 00384114).

Item #3:  Joi Jackson DBA Grow Cycling Foundation to host a Grow Cycling’s Second Saturdays
  Pumptrack Race Event at 700 Warren Lane, Edward Vincent Jr. Park- Inglewood
  Pumptrack; Public Property, on the second saturdaay of each month from Saturday, May
  11, 2024 - December 14, 2024 from 9:30 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.* July 13, 2024 scaled back;
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Applicant to hire two (2) Inglewood Police Officers; four (4) Licensed Security Guards to
  assist IPD with any potential crowd control, Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event
  shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules
  and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00384006).

Item # 4:  Lamarr House DBA GoodtimeFest, LLC to host a Good Time Fest Event at 3883 W Century
  Blvd., Hollywood Park Casino, Private Property, on Friday, May 24, 2024 from 6:00 p.m. –
  Inglewood Pum Track, Public Property, on Saturday, March 30, 2024, from 12:00 p.m. –
  9:00 p.m.; Saturday, May 25, 2024 from 6:00 p.m., and Sunday, May 26, 2024 from 6:00
  p.m. – 9:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Applicants must adhere to all department recommendations; Applicant to
  hire adequate Hollywood Park Security; A Watch Commander will be notified; Los Angeles
  Fire Department TBD Staff; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department;
  and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00383937).
 Permits & License Committee  March 28, 2024
Minutes  Page 3 of 4

Item # 5:  Gerardo Alejandre on behalf of ICEF Inglewood Elementary Charter to host an ICEF
  Inglewood 2024 Culminination Event at 700 Warren Lane, Edward Vincent Jr. Par, Public
  Property, on Tuesday, June 04, 2024, from 10:00 a.m. – 11:00 a.m; APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicants must
  adhere to Planning Department; Inglewood Police Department; Parks and Recteations
  Department Recommendations; Applicant to hire six (6) License Professional Security
  Guards; guards must be stationed at the women / men restrooms for public safety and to
  prevent any lewd act Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00383747).
New Business License Request (s):
Item # 6:  Afsar Ullah DBA Eagle Auto Wholesale to operate an Auto Cars (Used) at 1009 W Arbor
  Vitae St. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees; An expired or lapsed
  license for more than six months will negatively impact your business license renewal;
  Provide copy of Department of Motor Vehicles, Dealer License-Wholesale Only to the
  Finance Department;Strictly restricted to office use only;Automobiles are not permitted to
  be displayed for sale, parked or repaired on City streets, sidewalks and/or alleys;Subject
  to inspection by any Code Enforcement Officer or Police Officer;Adhere to all State,
  Federal, County and applicable IMC rules and regulations, including noise and
  signageFailure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation
  of your business license and any future business license application requests.
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384040).

Item # 7:  Hieu Luu DBA Billy Nails to operate as a Hair/Nail Salon at 3317 W. Manchester
  Blvd.APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must possess and
  maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City; Business owner
  shall provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies of applicable
  state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the establishment to
  the Finance Department;Parties, social events or gatherings of any type is strictly
  prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis
  activity) is not permitted on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the body is not
  permitted; Subject to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or any
  Peace Officer at any time to ensure compliance;10. Adhere to all State, Federal and
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to
  comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business
  license and any future business license application requests. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00384072).
 Permits & License Committee  March 28, 2024
